description:
List the works with their sizes, shelf, author and available languages. Call it at the start of a conversation about scripture, or when you need work slugs for filtering. The list is short by default: no descriptions.

Narrow it with `category` (a shelf: itihasa, purana, upanishad, vedanta, samhita, shastra, kavya, shruti, smriti; `shruti` is the upanishad shelf, `smriti` the itihasa and purana shelves) or with `author` (an id from list_authors). Set `include_descriptions` for a paragraph on each work.

It also tells you what is not translated: several works exist only in Russian. Check `languages` before promising the user an English text.

author.description: Only the works credited to this author id (see list_authors).

category.description: Only the works on this shelf.

include_descriptions.description: Add a paragraph describing each work. Default false.

language.description: Preferred language of the translations returned. Not a filter: works that exist only in Russian are returned in Russian, and each result says which language it is actually in. Default: en.

name: list_works
title: List the works in the library
